tasks.title: Add --json output to tl step list

fields.description: `tl step list` prints a table only. Add `--json` with the same fields, one object per task, so scripts need no text parsing.
fields.acceptance:
- `tl step list --json` prints one object per task.
- The fields match the table columns.
- The table output is unchanged without the flag.
fields.design: Reuse the status renderer's data and add a JSON encoder next to the table encoder. No new module.

tasks.title: Reject empty task titles at admission

fields.description: An empty title reaches the plan step and fails there. Refuse it at admission with a clear reason.
fields.acceptance:
- An empty or whitespace title is refused at admission.
- The refusal names the task and says why.
fields.design: Check in the admission validation, before any slot is reserved.

tasks.title: Plan: rounds log line for skipped tasks

fields.description: Every `skip` in a round should say why in one line, naming the task and the cause.
fields.acceptance:
- Every `skip` line names the task and the cause.
- No new log file.
fields.design: One helper formats every skip move; rounds call it.
fields.notes: Plan step: keep the diff small.

tasks.title: Show attempt deadline in tl step show

fields.description: The deadline of the running attempt is stored but not shown. Print it as an absolute time and the minutes left.
fields.acceptance:
- `tl step show` prints the deadline as an absolute time and the minutes left.
- A past deadline prints `expired`.
- One focused test.
fields.design: The deadline is already in the attempt row. Format it in the status renderer only.

tasks.title: Carry the entry lease through relaunch

repeat.reason: plan rejected: the change touches protected check configuration

fields.description: A relaunched entry loses its lease renewal. Carry the lease through relaunch without a new claim.
fields.acceptance:
- A relaunched entry keeps its lease renewal.
- No new claim is taken on relaunch.
- A test covers relaunch of an admitted attempt.
fields.design: Carry the lease object through `relaunch` instead of re-reading the claim. The change stays in entry code; check configuration is untouched.
fields.notes: Attempt 1 produced no diff; attempt 2 touched justfile and was rejected at plan.

tasks.title: Name the slot in hold reasons

fields.description: A hold reason names the task but not the slot it ran in. Add the slot name.
fields.acceptance:
- A hold reason names the task and the slot.
- Existing hold text tests pass.
fields.design: Pass the slot name into the hold text builder.

tasks.title: Trim trailing space in step list columns

fields.description: Table columns carry trailing spaces that break copy and paste.
fields.acceptance: - No trailing space in any table column.
fields.design: Strip in the one row formatter.

tasks.title: Reuse a pass across identical diffs
tasks.hold_cause: repeats_exhausted: three attempts failed at implement. Edit the task to narrow it, then add `auto` again.

fields.description: A pass should be reusable when the checked diff is byte-identical.
fields.acceptance:
- A stored pass is reused when the checked diff is byte-identical.
- A different diff never reuses a pass.
fields.design: Key the pass on a digest of the diff; look it up before running a check.
fields.notes: Three implement attempts ran into the 30 minute deadline running the whole suite.

fields.description: List changed check configuration files in the land summary.
fields.acceptance: - The land summary lists changed check configuration files.
fields.design: Reuse the changed-files list the land already computes.

tasks.title: Fix claim lease clock skew message

repeat.reason: checks failed: ruff found one unused import

fields.description: The message blamed the network when the clock was ahead.
fields.acceptance: - The lease message names clock skew when the clock is ahead.
fields.design: Compare local and tracker time before choosing the message.

tasks.title: Stabilize round log line order
tasks.hold_cause: repeats_exhausted: checks failed three times after a restart at plan. Narrow the task, then add `auto` again.

fields.description: Round log lines come out in dictionary order. Sort them by task id so two rounds on the same state print the same lines.
fields.acceptance:
- Round log lines are sorted by task id.
- Two rounds on the same state print the same lines.
- Types check cleanly.
fields.design: Sort once in the log writer, not in each move.
fields.notes: Six checks attempts failed on types in two starts from plan.
